JEE.note: Main route: JEE Main in January (and April if needed), then DASA/CIWG and the NITs and IIITs. School and CBSE board dates now sit in the calendar beside the ALLEN SCORE tests.

NTU.note: Application submitted by the family on 19 Nov 2026. First choice of the foreign universities.

milestones.title: School model exams finished (25 Nov to 7 Dec 2026)
milestones.detail: English 25 Nov, Physics 27 Nov, Mathematics 30 Nov, Computer Science 1 Dec, Chemistry 7 Dec. The official school schedule ends on 7 Dec; Physics pre-board practical is on 8 Dec. Chemistry and Computer Science practical dates still to be confirmed with the school.
milestones.source: Delhi Private School Dubai: Model Examination XII 2026-27 (family message, 19 Nov 2026)

milestones.title: Study Planner plan started: tasks ticked every day from 21 Nov 2026
milestones.detail: The plan runs to 9 Apr 2027: JEE Main first, then the CBSE boards. Chemistry first, then Physics, Mathematics only the sure questions.
milestones.source: Meeting of 18 Nov 2026 and the family's schedules of 19 Nov 2026

milestones.title: Three self-assessment PDFs (Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics) returned filled
milestones.detail: Returned on 20 Nov 2026. 11 of 69 topics are rated 0 or 1 and now come first in the Study Planner plan. Re-rate monthly (21 Dec, 18 Jan).

milestones.title: ALLEN SCORE-I: 11 tests and 10 previous-year papers attempted (30 Nov 2026 to 17 Jan 2027)
milestones.detail: Each paper reviewed the next day. Attempt only the sure questions; Chemistry first, then Physics, then Mathematics.

milestones.title: School pre-boards and CBSE practicals (4 to 28 Jan 2027) checked against the JEE Main admit card
milestones.detail: Physics 4 Jan, English 8 Jan, practical window 11 to 20 Jan, Chemistry 22 Jan, Mathematics 25 Jan, Computer Science 28 Jan. Chemistry and Mathematics fall inside the JEE Main window: ask the school for another date if the admit card clashes.
milestones.source: Delhi Private School Dubai: Preboard Examination I 2026-27

milestones.title: JEE Main Session 1 result and the decision on Session 2
milestones.detail: Best score of the two sessions counts. Session 2 is expected in early April, overlapping the CBSE Computer Science paper (31 Mar) and the end of the board window (9 Apr). Decide after the Session 1 result.
milestones.source: NTA calendar as reported, Nov 2026 (dates to be confirmed by NTA)

milestones.title: CBSE Class 12 board exams (16 Feb to 9 Apr 2027): Physics 16 Feb, Chemistry 27 Feb, English 5 Mar, Mathematics 9 Mar, Computer Science 31 Mar
milestones.detail: Physics is the first paper, 16 days after JEE Main Session 1 ends and one day before the NUS deadline. NTU asks for a minimum of 93% average including English; the school predicted 95%. Confirm the dates on cbse.gov.in.
milestones.source: CBSE Class 12 date sheet 2027 as reported by Careers360, 6 Nov 2026

milestones.title: NTU application submitted by the family
milestones.detail: Reported on 19 Nov 2026. Window closes 19 March 2027. Offers depend on predicted marks first and are confirmed on the board results.

milestones.title: Decide whether NUS stays on the list before the Physics board paper
milestones.detail: Window 16 Dec 2026 to 17 Feb 2027; the Physics paper is on 16 Feb. Document upload should be complete before 16 Dec.
milestones.source: NUS dates as noted on 30 Oct 2026; CBSE date sheet as reported on 6 Nov 2026

milestones.title: Study in India (SII) shortlist: 11 colleges reviewed as a backup (March and April)
milestones.detail: NIT Warangal, Tiruchirappalli, Surathkal, Calicut, Rourkela, MNIT Jaipur, DTU, IIIT Delhi, VIT Vellore, Manipal and BITS Pilani. Mentor advice of 20 Nov: last option, do not spend time now, revisit in March and April.
